macros.name: forceRowHeight
macros.doc: \forceRowHeight{value} enforce current row minimum height to value.

macros.name: lb
macros.doc: Line break in table cell can be do with \lb (shortcut for \linebreak), \linebreak or \newline.

macros.name: nextRow
macros.doc: Each row (even last) MUST be ended with \nextRow command (insted of \\ or \tabularnewline).

macros.name: setMultiColumn
macros.doc: \setMultiColumn{col num}{max width}{min width}{hmode}{vmode}{left sep}{right sep}{text} command allow create multi column cell.

macros.name: setMultiRow
macros.doc: \setMultiRow{col num}[minimal height]{text} command allow create multi row cell.

macros.name: tableFormatedCell
macros.doc: \tableFormatedCell{max width}[min width]{hmode}{vmode} command allow change formatting for single cell.
